speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, please describe your symptoms in detail. When did your fever and abdominal tenderness start, and have you experienced any vaginal bleeding, foul-smelling discharge, or severe pain since delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Uterine Infection (Endometritis) with possible urinary retention or ileus.

I have noted the postpartum fever, uterine tenderness, and the concerning finding of decreased bowel sounds after a prolonged labor with an 11-pound baby. Please confirm if you have had any foul-smelling lochia, and I need to see the results of your Urinalysis, CBC with differential, and a Pelvic Exam immediately. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis; REQUEST TEST: CBC_with_differential; REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_Ultrasound.
